papers.title: Frontocentral theta oscillations bias perceptual judgments of ambiguous visual causality.

papers.title: EEG Microstate Alterations and Their Association with Cognitive Performance in Late-Onset Epilepsy of Unknown Etiology: Comparison with Alzheimer's Disease.
papers.reason: It links resting-state EEG microstate features to cognitive performance and clinical groups including AD, making it relevant to electrophysiological biomarkers of cognitive impairment though not specifically executive-function modelling.

papers.title: Long-term Electroclinical Outcomes After Herpes Simplex Virus Encephalitis: A Single-Center Case Series.

papers.title: Linguistic features from constrained spontaneous speech as potential markers of preclinical Alzheimer’s disease
